chinese: 人们与许多奇妙的动物和谐共处！
english: People live side by side with many wonderful animals!

chinese: 在美国纽约，现在是早上7点。
english: It’s 7:00 in the morning in New York, USA.

chinese: 时间还早，但这座城市已经开始忙碌起来！
english: It’s early, but the city is getting busy!

chinese: 许多人正匆匆赶往地铁站。
english: Many people are rushing to the subway.

chinese: 亮黄色的出租车正在接送乘客。
english: Bright yellow taxis are picking up and dropping off passengers.

chinese: 一些人在中央公园里慢跑、散步和骑自行车。
english: Some people are jogging, walking, and riding bikes in Central Park.

chinese: 另一些人则在咖啡馆里喝咖啡、吃早餐。
english: Others are drinking coffee and eating breakfast in coffee shops.
